[ REPUBLIC ACT No. 11496]

AN ACT INCREASING THE BED CAPACITY OF THE
WESTERN VISAYAS MEDICAL CENTER IN
MANDURRIAO, ILOILO CITY FROM FOUR HUNDRED
TWENTY-FIVE (425) BEDS TO SEVEN HUNDRED
(700) BEDS, UPGRADING ITS PROFESSIONAL
HEALTH CARE SERVICES AND FACILITIES,
AUTHORIZING THE INCREASE OF ITS MEDICAL
PERSONNEL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS
THEREFOR

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the
Philippines in Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. The authorized bed capacity of the Western
Visayas Medical Center (WVMC) located in Mandurriao, Iloilo
City is hereby increased from four hundred twenty-five (425) beds
to seven hundred (700) beds.

SEC. 2. The existing professional health care services and
facilities of the WVMC are hereby upgraded to conform with and
 

be commensurate to the increase in its bed capacity as provided
in Section 1 hereof.

SEC. 3. The existing workforce of the WVMC shall also be
correspondingly increased. The Secretary of the Department of
Health (DOH), in coordination with the Secretary of the
Department of Budget and Management (DBM), the Commissioner
of the Civil Service Commission (CSC) and the Chief of the WVMC,
shall determine the additional plantilla positions to be created
and filled up.

SEc. 4. Any future increase in bed capacity, service
capability and staffing requirements shall be consistent with
the hospital development plan, which shall be prepared and
submitted by the Medical Center Chief of the WVMC to the
DOH to reflect the developmental goals of the hospital.

SEc. 5. The Secretary of Health shall immediately
include in the Department’s programs the implementation
of this Act, the funding of which shall be included in the annual
General Appropriations Act.

SEC. 6. If any provision or part of this Act is declared
unconstitutional, the remaining parts or provisions not affected
shall remain in full force and effect.

SEC. 7. All other laws, decrees, orders, issuances, rules
and regulations or parts thereof which are inconsistent with the
provisions of this Act are hereby repealed, amended or modified
accordingly.

SEC. 8. This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its

publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general
circulation.

Approved,
